stem.text: Sound waves of wavelength $\lambda$ are emitted by a loudspeaker and pass through two slits P and Q. Two sound waves from the slits meet at R.

stem.alt: Loudspeaker on the left, facing a vertical sound barrier with two slits P and Q; a microphone at R on a vertical dashed line to the right of the barrier

stem.text: What is the condition for an intensity maximum (loud sound) to be detected by a microphone at R?

A.text: The amplitudes of the two waves at R must be the same.

B.text: The distance PQ must be smaller than the wavelength $\lambda$.

C.text: The two waves from the slits must have travelled the same distance to R.

D.text: The two waves must be in phase at R.
